top.name: Siege Engine
top.rules_text: Deploy a Siege Engine on an empty tile within 2 (20 HP, 10 DMG, range 6). Immobile; 2 turn setup.

bottom.name: Emergency Scuttle
bottom.rules_text: Destroy all your constructs. Each detonates for 5 damage to adjacent enemies. Every loss advances your Schematics.
